what: TCPMT revision: local solder-joint studies answering the reviewer (critical joint, cycle stabilisation, averaging band, constitutive law)

averaging_band.what: averaging-band sensitivity at the cooling-A Z1 and Z2 critical joints (task 3)

stabilization.what: cycle stabilisation of the six tier responses (task 2)
stabilization.stabilised_value_rule: the 48-cycle run's last-cycle increment; U_cyc(stab) = max(|v48 - v40|, |v48 - Aitken limit|, |v48 - v_inf of an exponential fit to cycles 29-48|) / v48; a 16-cycle value carries U_cyc = |v16 - v48| / v48 + U_cyc(stab)
stabilization.u_rule: U = U_mesh + U_time + U_cyc; U_mesh, U_time from local_mesh_study.json (own case, or the largest production value for cases without a mesh study); 4-cycle U_cyc = |v16 - v4| / v16 as the policy defines it
stabilization.u_card_grid_rule: U_stab_num adds the case's card-grid sensitivity |v(7-row production card) - v(same card rebuilt on 2.5 C rows)| / v(2.5 C rows) (tcpmt_solder_units_check.py): the solver's linear-in-A interpolation between the 25 C-spaced rows, which the policy U does not contain
stabilization.u_conservative_rule: U_stab_num plus the largest L0 -> L3 offset of the production cases (0.0313), since the tier values are L0

numerical_tolerance.what: equilibrium-tolerance, unit-basis and card-grid checks of the production local model (production card, L0, production settings)
numerical_tolerance.mechanism: CalculiX interpolates the Norton A linearly between card rows; the production rows are 25 C apart with n varying, so the effective law at a joint temperature between rows depends on the unit basis and differs from the intended Arrhenius construction

alternative_law.alloy: SnAgCu (near-eutectic SAC); applied to SAC305 in the citing literature
alternative_law.source: Schubert, Dudek, Auerswald, Gollhardt, Michel, Reichl, 'Fatigue life models for SnAgCu and SnPb solder joints evaluated by experiments and simulation', Proc. 53rd ECTC, 2003, pp. 603-610, doi:10.1109/ECTC.2003.1216343 (bib key Schubert2003ECTC)

mapping.solver_form: eps_dot = A(T) (sigma_vm - sigma_y)^n(T), sigma_y = 1e-06 MPa flat (zero yield, audit rule)
mapping.fit: least squares in ln(rate) vs ln(sigma), 400 log-spaced points over the window
mapping.window_primary: time-weighted: 5-95 % quantiles of the von Mises stress weighted by dt x volume (the stresses the joint spends the cycle at), per phase (hot dwell at T_joint, cold dwell at 25 C), union over the six tier joints; iteration 0 from the production solves, then re-read from the alternative-law solves
mapping.window_variant: strain-weighted (d(PEEQ) x volume) window of the production solves (iteration 0 of a strain-weighted scheme that cannot continue, see strain_it1_attempt)
mapping.temperature_assignment: cold window at T <= 25 C, hot window at T >= 75 C (below the coolest tier joint, 78.7 C), geometric blend between (never visited)
mapping.brackets: the converged window split at its geometric midpoint; the card refitted over each half
mapping.units: MPa (as production); a row whose least-squares A falls below the incplas.f floor of 1e-20 is constrained to A = 1.05e-20 and flagged

production_card_on_2p5C_grid.what: the production card rebuilt by solder_model.inp_material on 2.5 C rows, so the solver's linear-in-A interpolation follows the intended Arrhenius construction (tcpmt_solder_units_check.py)

critical_joint.candidate_rule: Pareto front in (du, T): a site is dropped only if another site has both a strictly larger du and a strictly larger T_joint; plus the four corners and the current critical (max-du) site

monotonicity_pairs.test: for every pair of computed points (all candidates of all cases and the grid) with du_p >= du_q and T_p >= T_q (one strict), d_eps_p >= d_eps_q
